release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.31 (Build 31) - Logo Implementation & Icon Updates:
- Integrated SOCLogo.png as the official app logo across all platforms
- Updated app icon with white background for better visibility on home screens
- Enhanced logo display in login and registration screens
- Improved adaptive icon configuration with proper padding for full logo visibility
- Updated flutter_launcher_icons to latest version (0.14.4) for better icon generation
- Consistent logo usage throughout the application
- Better logo rendering with proper sizing and background support
- Web platform logo updates in loading screen and manifest
- Improved app branding and visual identity
